audit_findings.finding: Cloud mixed account, view, filter, selection and sort roles in a competing stack.
audit_findings.resolution: Account row, view tabs, one search row, flat column sorting; left scan and right selection footer.

audit_findings.finding: Cloud Clear selection inherited a footer height with row-button corner geometry.
audit_findings.resolution: Uses the shared full-size secondary footer action.

audit_findings.finding: Software had separate Rescan, count, select-all and empty history bands.
audit_findings.resolution: Rescan joins search, header owns checkbox, history collapses; headings align with row names.

audit_findings.finding: Details focus looked like update selection; select-all could include search-hidden packages.
audit_findings.resolution: Tint follows checked update selection; filtered header eligibility is guarded by a regression asserting the reviewed package.

audit_findings.finding: Program/Driver/Software details buried useful fields and actions in tall stacks.
audit_findings.resolution: Named product header, paired principal values, collapsed technical data and pinned relevant actions.

audit_findings.finding: Driver restore action fell below the dialog scroll area.
audit_findings.resolution: Single typed Review restore action sits in the footer and is exercised through cancellation.

audit_findings.finding: Cloud partial-scan issues could expand without bound before results.
audit_findings.resolution: Incomplete warning remains visible, issue list uses a disclosure.

audit_findings.finding: Settings About wrapped to a second tab row at the 920px reference window.
audit_findings.resolution: The label-only tab family uses shared 8px inner padding; the rendered seven-tab group fits one line.

audit_findings.finding: Driver Released sorting was hidden by a width threshold at the default wide window.
audit_findings.resolution: The update tab uses Drivers, New version and Released; installed/state columns belong to unknown/history views. Unknown dates keep reasons in a tooltip.

audit_findings.finding: The Driver row checkbox child shrank its 32px column to 24px and shifted all data 8px left of the headings.
audit_findings.resolution: The row selection child now preserves the declared column width; actual rendered values and heading axes are compared again.
